about_the_game:
You're standing on the edge of a beach where the waves don't wash up seashells or seafoam, but plastic bottles, torn bags, and rusted metal.

For years, this city had been under the influence of outcasts who turned it into a carefree retreat where no one cared about order or nature. Gradually, it sank into piles of garbage, and even attempts to save it brought no results. But one day, a major crisis put an end to it all.

The court, unwilling to waste time, took the beach away from the residents and handed it over to the local authorities with an order to clean it up. The authorities, however, had no desire to bear such a burden, so they shifted the responsibility onto the first person who broke the law.

That person is you.

A choice you once made brought you here. Now your debts and mistakes have become your sentence: long, grueling work under the scorching sun.

At first, it feels simple - pick up the trash, bag it, drag it to the drop-off. But step by step, you realize the beach never ends. Behind every pile of waste lies not only someone else's mess, but your own. Sometimes you come across things that feel like treasures - not the kind worth money, but items that once meant the world to someone. Worthless, yet carrying entire stories within them.

In this game, you are a convict paying for the past through labor.

Sort and haul the garbage, feel the fatigue and the heat, and fight with your own doubts. With every bag, you get closer to clearing your debt - and maybe, to a second chance.

The beach is your trial. The work is your punishment. And freedom will be your reward.

short_description: You are a cleaner not by choice, but by necessity. A single-player eco-activist simulator that aims to bring life back to an old beach in a provincial town. Explore abandoned embankments and courtyards, collect rubbish, sort resources, and uncover the history of this forgotten place.
